about: ROUTE R1, THE RIVER ROAD (One World phase 4.1, the owner's north routes thread, 2026-11-17): the highway from the Vatican's east gate (opened for it) east across the river meadow, over the Tiber on a bridge (R1.js), through open woodland to Disaster City's Hills, which it enters on their west side at row -3 (the Hills' old west way `ridge`, re-pointed). ONE room, 14 plots (8 x 2): the plots 0,-4 and 1,-4 at its east end are the junction where the Canyon Trail (R2) starts north; the trail's first stretch is in this room (`with`) and leaves north at x 1. Joined to the Vatican (24 plots) or to the city it would pass the rule's 30 plots. PLACES (ow-places.js, every name an idea of Claude's): the design page gives 'the bridge over the Tiber into Civic Center' (the bridge is R1.js); the ranger station that the page puts on the Canyon Trail stands at the junction where the trail starts. Two plots carry no place: the gate plot (-6,-4: the bridge is its place) and -1,-3, where the road drops into the Hills' row.
label: THE RIVER ROAD
sub: THE HIGHWAY · THE VATICAN TO THE CITY · 14 PLOTS
